# First Deal

A shared standard-deck card table for two to four people. First Deal is a sandbox: agree on a card game with your friends; this release does not award a winner automatically.

## The deck

The deck has 52 distinct cards and no jokers. A fresh, unshuffled deck groups Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, then Spades, with Ace, 2 through 10, Jack, Queen, and King in each suit.

## Set up

Shuffle the deck and have each player use Draw card to take the number of cards your chosen rules require. A drawn card goes into that player's private hand. Inspect a card to read its identity; other players do not see that private hand in the official client.

## Play and reveal

Select a hand card to inspect it. Drag a card onto the table, or open its actions and choose Play to table. The deck sits left of the central play area, so a card played to the center stays visible. Cards keep their face-down state when played. Open a table card's actions and choose Flip when your rules call for revealing it. A face-down table card's identity stays hidden in its context menu and inspector.

## Finish

Use the victory conditions of the game your group agreed on. Leaving a table and ending the table are separate actions; only the current host can end it for everyone.
